frontMatter.content.hideFmMessage: Use the News metadata form to edit these fields.

fields.title: Image
fields.name: src
fields.description: Choose or upload a WebP file under public/images; put new News images in public/images/news.

fields.title: Alt text
fields.name: alt
fields.description: Describe what the figure shows for someone who cannot see it; do not repeat the caption.

fields.title: Caption
fields.name: caption
fields.description: One concise sentence explaining why the figure belongs with this update.

fields.title: Credit
fields.name: credit
fields.description: Name the public paper/source or identify this as your original image.

fields.title: Public source link
fields.name: sourceUrl
fields.description: For a published figure, link to the DOI or canonical public source.

fields.title: Headline
fields.name: title
fields.description: A short, specific headline. It is also used to generate the filename.

fields.title: Date
fields.name: date
fields.description: Use the date of the public announcement or event.

fields.title: One-sentence summary
fields.name: summary
fields.description: Shown on the Home and News pages; keep it factual and understandable on its own.

fields.title: Related publication
fields.name: publicationId
fields.description: Choose a paper only when the announcement is about it. The site supplies its citation and DOI.
